# windowsddi_dhcp_exclusion_range (Resource)

Manages an IPv4 exclusion range within a scope (`Add-DhcpServerv4ExclusionRange`, `Remove-DhcpServerv4ExclusionRange`). There is no update: every change replaces the range.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Keep the first addresses of the scope for static assignments.
resource "windowsddi_dhcp_exclusion_range" "static" {
  scope_id    = windowsddi_dhcp_scope.users.scope_id
  start_range = "10.1.20.10"
  end_range   = "10.1.20.20"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_range` (String) Last excluded IPv4 address.
- `scope_id` (String) Scope the exclusion range belongs to.
- `start_range` (String) First excluded IPv4 address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scope_id>/<start_range>-<end_range>`, for example `10.1.2.0/10.1.2.1-10.1.2.20`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <scope_id>/<start_range>-<end_range>.
terraform import windowsddi_dhcp_exclusion_range.static 10.1.20.0/10.1.20.10-10.1.20.20
```
